_comment: Source of truth for the handbook's Overview section (add-ons diagram + table).
Rendered by lib/gen-addons-docs.py into docs/overview/addons.md and
docs/assets/diagrams/addons.svg. The generator ALSO drift-checks this file
against the live config tree: every .nix file under config/{plugins,ui,
utility,assistant} (except default.nix) must be referenced by some entry's
'configs' list, or the build fails. Add a plugin -> add it here, or CI breaks.
Each add-on: name, category (must exist in 'categories'), purpose (one line),
url (upstream project), enabled (false = shipped but off by default),
configs (the config/*.nix file(s) that wire it).
